design: Independent holdout; exclude all pilot tapes from inference. 128 adjacent order-pairs, fresh real-time engine launch for each arm. Odd pairs control then candidate, even pairs candidate then control. Same saved binaries, source, dm2 graph, engine, PAKs, CLI, skill1. Native listen cadence, no seed or frametime override; scratch1 591 common timing probe, scratch4 0 diagnostics off.
primary: Native brief totals.engages *60 / totals.duration_sec, candidate minus control within each order-pair. Engage events mark enemy acquisition, not shots/damage or a direct skill score. Mean difference, paired two-sided 95% Student-t CI, df127. Confirm reproducible decrease only if both its upper endpoint and the block-bootstrap 95% upper endpoint are below zero. A t-only decrease with discordant block sensitivity is not called noise.
equivalence: Separate paired two-sided 90% Student-t CI strictly inside [-2,+2] engagements per match-minute, TOST alpha .05, and four-pair block-bootstrap 90% CI strictly inside the same bounds. This is a newly declared perception engagement margin, independent of the unchanged earlier step0 goal-rate bounds. A detected decrease takes precedence even when small enough to satisfy equivalence. Otherwise practical equivalence supports earlier drop consistent with noise. Nonsignificance alone is inconclusive; a significant robust increase means the earlier decrease was not reproduced.
existing_floor: Retain existing dm2 0.65 engagement-retention collapse threshold. Report candidate-0.65*control paired 90% CI: lower endpoint >0 supports non-inferiority at one-sided alpha .05; upper endpoint <0 confirms collapse. This secondary threshold cannot turn a reproducible smaller drop into noise.

bootstrap.method: Fixed consecutive non-overlapping four-pair blocks, resample 32 blocks with replacement and compute mean; percentile confidence intervals

power_limits: Planning model uses normal pair differences with conservative SD6 versus pilot SD2.3136; power simulations concern paired-t tests only, not a guarantee under drift, serial dependence or block-sensitivity agreement. No guarantee of resolving true effects at a bound.
secondary: Native goals, frags, deaths, stalls, lava_deaths, freezes, acquisitions, grabs with descriptive paired 95% CIs; no multiplicity-adjusted secondary claims. Report both run-order strata, CPU, native closest approach/coverage/avg_speed/freezes, flags, output volume and cadence/tails. Native band compare with primary engagements is contextual, never the statistical decision rule.
timing: Use identical BHVTIME probe. Discard first full five-second window for weighted mean cadence, retain all complete windows and >20/>50ms tails separately. Report mean difference 90% CI widened by +/-0.1ms for rounding; compare descriptively with +/-1ms. Last partial window unobserved. No exclusion for ordinary freezes, stalls, losses, zero engagements or tail spikes.
validity: Every attempt retained. Native map dm2, tick_class listen, native duration58..64 seconds; >=10 complete timing windows before startup exclusion. No controlled fixture/diagnostic output or engine-error markers. All source/binary/nav/CLI/code/resource hashes checked throughout. Technical invalidity stops execution and preserves raw tape/attempt receipt; investigate and log a technical amendment before any replacement. No gameplay-outcome exclusions. If replacing a tape with usable native metric, report first-attempt sensitivity too.
stopping: Exactly256 valid matches, no interim primary confidence intervals, significance looks, optional stopping or outcome-based sample expansion. Technical/user interruption may resume missing cells only under frozen registration. Incomplete cohort has no noise/regression decision. Do not reuse native SPRT suggestions to extend the fixed holdout.
holds: No QC, health/inventory, projectile-perception, nav or other gameplay changes. No compile or deployment. Stage only workspace engine/argus/progs.dat during a test; restore original bytes after every attempt and on completion/interruption. game/argus and compiler binaries remain original.
